scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace server && npm run lint --workspace client
scripts.start: npm run start --workspace server & npm run preview --workspace client
scripts.docker:migrate: docker-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec api npm run migrate
scripts.docker:seed: docker-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec api npm run seed
